component.name: uConsole for DSPi
component.summary: Set up and control a DSPi audio processor

description.p: DSPi turns a Raspberry Pi Pico (RP2040) or Pico 2 (RP2350) into a USB sound card with a digital signal processor inside it. This app is where you shape that processing.

ul.li: Draw EQ curves directly on a response graph
Route any input to any output and align speakers in time
Add loudness compensation, headphone crossfeed and other effects
Wire up physical knobs and remotes, and keep everything in presets on the device
Share devices on the local network
